name: cristiano_only
description: Design of the paper: every trained component is fitted on the Cristiano cohort (discovery cohort) only. Tissue of origin in new cohorts is the label-free prior (47 features, no trained parameter); the residual graph network and the global classifier are trained on the 243 Cristiano cancers with a class label (stratified 20% validation split) and are used in full mode. Cancer score: five components with equal, pre-specified weights; module LR, detection graph network, global LR and DELFI coverage LR trained on the 539 Cristiano genomes.
